narr: Scattered thunderstorms along a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central and south central Virginia.
ev: Multiple roadways were flooded in the Manchester neighborhood of Richmond.
Street flooding was reported along Anderson Highway (Route 60). A couple of vehicles were stranded.
Multiple roadways were flooded across Powhatan.
Significant water on a roadway caused large limbs and debris to collect on a storm drain. Spotter also reported that approximately 4 inches of rain fell.
Sky Line Road was impassable due to water on roadway.
Heavy rainfall caused concrete blocks to wash away. Rainfall totals between two and four inches were reported.
Route 155 was closed due to standing water. Rainfall total of 2.85 inches was reported.
Standing water was reported on north and south bound lanes of Interstate 95 through downtown Richmond. Rainfall totals between two and three inches were reported.
Standing water was reported on portions of the southbound lanes of Interstate 95 on the south side of Richmond.
